title: CTEs
explain: A CTE, written with `WITH`, gives a name to a query so you can use it like a temporary table. It breaks a long query into readable steps and can be referenced more than once. Think of it as naming an intermediate result.
exercise: Rewrite the subquery from the last lesson using a CTE that holds the course averages.
tip: In some databases a CTE is recomputed each time you reference it. If a step is slow, check the query plan.
